image_description: A blue plastic barrel positioned outdoors against a cinder block wall, functioning as a rainwater collection vessel. A white downspout with a black flexible elbow extends into the open top of the barrel. The barrel features horizontal reinforcing ribs and a spigot near the base on the right side. Ferns grow in the foreground, and a red-handled shovel leans against a fence in the background.
